title: Coordinate Steiner symmetrization: reflection symmetries
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, j ∈ Fin d and let A ⊆ ℝ^d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) be arbitrary. For y ∈ ℝ^d, i ∈ Fin d and t ∈ ℝ let y[i↦t] be y with its i-th coordinate replaced by t (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp i t)), R_i(y) := y[i↦−y_i] (reflection in the coordinate hyperplane x_i = 0), A^j_y := {t ∈ ℝ : y[j↦t] ∈ A}, λ(y) := (L¹(A^j_y)).toReal (L¹ = Lebesgue measure on ℝ), and S_j(A) := {y ∈ ℝ^d : A^j_y ≠ ∅ and |y_j| ≤ λ(y)/2}. Then (a) R_j(y) ∈ S_j(A) for every y ∈ S_j(A); and (b) for every i ∈ Fin d with i ≠ j: if R_i(x) ∈ A for all x ∈ A, then R_i(y) ∈ S_j(A) for all y ∈ S_j(A).
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d) (A : Set (Euclid d)), (∀ x ∈ {y : Euclid d | {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |y j| ≤ (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal / 2}, WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update x.ofLp j (-x j)) ∈ {y : Euclid d | {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |y j| ≤ (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal / 2}) ∧ ∀ i : Fin d, i ≠ j → (∀ x ∈ A, WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update x.ofLp i (-x i)) ∈ A) → ∀ x ∈ {y : Euclid d | {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |y j| ≤ (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal / 2}, WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update x.ofLp i (-x i)) ∈ {y : Euclid d | {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |y j| ≤ (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal / 2}
